$comment: The commands an idle batch (HR-5; futon or kazaana typed with --idle) runs unattended, one exemplar per shape, each with the skill that runs it (zheref/hatsu#453 AC-3). It grants NOTHING: contracts/permissions.json is the one source of the packs, and a permission setting is the maintainer's alone. scripts/idle_permissions_check.mts reads the session's own Claude Code settings and lists every exemplar no allow rule matches (and any a deny rule matches), so the maintainer sees before the first claim which steps would prompt — and under --idle a prompt nobody answers is a harness refusal, row harness-denied (WORKFLOW § Idle batches rule 2). An auto-mode classifier refusal is not predictable from the files and is not listed; it parks as g5-harness-denied when it happens. Placeholders in angle brackets stand for any value.
